caption_L1: Here a line graph is called Synthetic crude oil production in Canada from 1998 to 2018 (in 1,000 cubic meters). A linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015 can be found along the x-axis, labeled Year. Production in thousand cubic meters is plotted along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: Synthetic crude oil production in Canada started low in 1998 at 19000 cubic meters but there has been a steady incline in production to 2019. At 2019 production was at its highest at 60500 cubic meters. There was a dip in production in 2005 to 20000 cubic meters then a steady rise until a slight dip in 2008 to 39000 cubic meters. Since then there has been a steady increase in production until another slight dip to 55000 cubic meters mid way through 2016.
